definitions.gloss: spoken language — the form of language used in speech, as opposed to writing; colloquial style
definitions.explanation: Language as it is actually spoken in conversation, including casual phrasing, sentence-ending particles, contractions, and rhythms of speech that differ from the more formal and tightly structured forms used in writing. Contrasts with {書|か}き{言葉|ことば} ('written language').

examples.japanese: ⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{話|はな}し{言葉|ことば}です。
{話|はな}し{言葉|ことば}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{書|か}き{言葉|ことば}→書き言葉：25961_kakikotoba⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧。
examples.english: Spoken language and written language are different.

examples.japanese: ⟦レポート→レポート：01543_repooto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{話|はな}し{言葉|ことば}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いけません→いける：06957_ikeru⟧。
examples.english: You must not use colloquial language in a report.

examples.japanese: {若|わか}い⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{話|はな}し{言葉|ことば}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{表現|ひょうげん}→表現：03584_hyougen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦{出|で}てくる→出てくる：29121_detekuru⟧。
examples.english: A lot of new expressions appear in the colloquial speech of young people.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧ ('to speak') and ⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧ ('words, language'). Literally 'speaking words.'

USAGE:
- Refers to the style of language actually used when speaking, including casual particles (⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧, ⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧, さ), contractions (〜ちゃう, 〜⟦なきゃ→ない：01118_nai⟧), and looser grammar.
- Often contrasted explicitly with ⟦{書|か}き{言葉|ことば}→書き言葉：25961_kakikotoba⟧ in discussions of style, writing advice, and language teaching.
- In writing classes and style guides, using {話|はな}し{言葉|ことば} in formal documents is typically marked as inappropriate.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {話|はな}し{言葉|ことば}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{書|か}き{言葉|ことば}→書き言葉：25961_kakikotoba⟧: spoken and written language
- {話|はな}し{言葉|ことば}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧: to use colloquial/spoken language
- {話|はな}し{言葉|ことば}{調|ちょう}: a conversational style/tone
- くだけた{話|はな}し{言葉|ことば}: informal spoken language

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{口語|こうご}→口語：12033_kougo⟧: spoken/colloquial language — a more technical linguistic term; also refers to modern Japanese as opposed to classical ⟦{文語|ぶんご}→文語：12991_bungo⟧.
- ⟦{書|か}き{言葉|ことば}→書き言葉：25961_kakikotoba⟧: written language — the direct antonym.
- ⟦{会話|かいわ}→会話：01271_kaiwa⟧: conversation — refers to the act of speaking with someone, not the style of language itself.
